# Findable London
> Findable London (findable.london) is a Finchley-based service, founded by Nick Cresner, that helps plumbers and other trades in North London and Hertfordshire get found on Google Maps and recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Copilot.

Name: Findable London (formerly written just "Findable"). Website: https://findable.london/. Not affiliated with other businesses that use the name Findable.

Site: https://findable.london/
Audience: plumbers (and, in a test, electricians) in North London and Hertfordshire: Finchley, Barnet, Muswell Hill, Hendon, Enfield, Haringey and nearby Hertfordshire towns (starting with N2, N3, N12, EN4, EN5, NW7)

## What we offer
- Free 2-minute self-check on this site (no login)
- Free full audit (map searches + AI assistants)
- Profile Fix-Up (recommended first step): £129 one-off, 30-day money-back guarantee (refunded in full if requested by email to hello@findable.london within 30 days of payment, no questions asked) — buy: https://buy.stripe.com/14A5kw1Hh7mtazC4xF1Jm00
- Findable Essentials (visibility): first month free (14-day trial, nothing to pay at checkout), then £59/month. Google posts, review replies, hours and Q&A, monthly map and AI-assistant recheck — buy: https://buy.stripe.com/7sYbIUdpZbCJazC2px1Jm01
- Findable Pro (visibility + admin automations): first month free (14-day trial, nothing to pay at checkout), then £99/month. Everything in Essentials plus missed-call text-back, appointment confirmations and reminders (reply YES, or R to reschedule) and review requests after every job (no incentives) — buy: https://buy.stripe.com/8x23co71BbCJ37a8NV1Jm02
- Founding pilot (first 5 North London businesses): Profile Fix-Up free plus the first month on Findable Pro free, in exchange for a 5-minute feedback form and case-study permission — apply: https://findable.london/?offer=pilot#audit
- Start with the £129 Profile Fix-Up, or a free audit if you want to see the gaps first.

## Guides
- How to get your plumbing business recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants (plain answers, sourced, updated 18 Oct 2026): https://findable.london/ai-visibility/

## How it works
1. Free audit of Google profile, local map searches and AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, Grok; the same fixed questions are rerun later for a dated before/after)
2. Fix-up with customer approval on every change
3. Bing Places, Apple Business and key directory listings kept consistent; monthly posts, review replies and AI rechecks; on Pro, missed-call text-back, reminders and review requests

## Important facts
- We never ask for Google passwords; customers add us as a Manager
- No fake reviews, no ranking guarantees
- Rolling monthly plans, no minimum term, cancel any time by emailing hello@findable.london
- Not a lead site: no lead fees, credits or shortlist charges; customers find the business on Google and call it directly
- Monthly plans: nothing to pay at checkout; the first monthly payment is 14 days later, cancel before then and pay nothing
- The Google Business Profile, photos and reviews always belong to the business; Findable London is only a Manager and removes itself on cancellation

## Who's behind it
- Founded by Nick Cresner, a Finchley local who spent nine years mapping Britain's roads at Navteq and HERE, then worked as a web developer, on a maintenance team and as a property manager.
- Nick Cresner online: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nickcresner/ and https://nickcresner.com/
- Not affiliated with Google. Findable London never asks for a Google password or verification code, never takes payment over the phone and never threatens to remove a listing; the business stays the owner and adds Findable London as a Manager itself.

## Contact
Request a free audit via the form at https://findable.london/#audit (submissions are emailed to us; we reply within 2 working days), or email hello@findable.london
